metadata.protocolName: MIC of Piper betle extract against multidrug-resistant bacteria
metadata.author: paper2protocol
metadata.description: Broth microdilution MIC (CLSI M07-A8) replicating Bernardo et al., PLOS ONE 11(1):e0146349 (2016), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0146349. Thirteen-point two-fold series of Piper betle extract in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth spanning 10,000 down to 2.44 ug/mL; 10 uL of adjusted inoculum into each well containing 100 uL of extract; triplicate throughout.

metadata.displayName: Opentrons 15 Tube Rack with Falcon 15 mL Conical

params.message: HANDOFF: seal trays; incubate 16-20 h at 35 +/- 2 C in ambient air. MIC = lowest concentration with no growth vs the culture control.
HANDOFF: MBC - subculture each no-growth well with a 10 uL loop onto 5% sheep blood agar, 16-20 h at 35 +/- 2 C.
HANDOFF: reference-drug controls - the paper does not report the reference antibiotic's dilution series, so it is not reproduced here.
